title: $30 or $12 for the same AI model. Which one do you pay?
description:
Same model. Two prices. The difference is where you get your API key.

We compared the real price per 1M tokens — official rates vs. the
cheapest available — for GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Fable 5
and Gemini 3.1 Pro.

The discount is not the same for every model: on some it's −20%,
on others −60%. So the only way to know your number is to look it up.

Full price table (free, no signup):
https://bestaigateways com

Prices as of July 2026. Set by each provider and subject to change —
always verify before you build.

#AI #API #OpenAI #Claude #Gemini #LLM #DevTools #Shorts
